reason: Twelve socket harnesses (406 declared assertions) carry this project's regression, but they do not yet own the whole server lifecycle: unique_login_e2e.py needs a binary that the main worktree does not build (FINDING-GATE-2). Declared here so the set is checkable and auditable rather than living as ten unregistered scripts. Flip to `enforced` after FINDING-GATE-2 closes.
